headline: Asia: Russian strikes kill at least 12 in Kyiv region, Ukraine says
script:
Good evening. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- Asia: Russian strikes kill at least 12 in Kyiv region, Ukraine says.
- India: Trump threatens fresh strikes on Iran after New Year if talks fail.
- Australia: Drone strikes kill four in Khartoum and damage UN building.

Full breakdown follows.

NORTH AMERICA
The Caribbean - bottom line: Robbers reach end of road with rare armoured car heist convictions.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 21 hours ago: Robbers reach end of road with rare armoured car heist convictions.
A string of robberies targeting armoured money-courier companies has yielded two convictions in two months, but the attacks continue, with the latest incident occurring in Liguanea, St Andrew, earlier this month. The two recent convictions mark the first time in 17 years that individuals have faced sentencing following successful prosecutions for offences linked to armoured-car robberies since the last such conviction in 2009.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 21 hours ago: Generations bound by Howard.
WESTERN BUREAU: For generations, Howard University has been a home away from home for Jamaicans, where families have sent their children to acquire world-class skills, build successful careers and forge friendships that last a lifetime. From engineers and architects to doctors and lawyers, the historically Black institution in Washington, DC, has helped shape the professional journeys of Jamaicans, with some families establishing traditions that span generations.
United States: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.
Central America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

SOUTH AMERICA
South America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

EUROPE
Western Russia - bottom line: Woman killed and nine injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 9 hours ago: Woman killed and nine injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.
Strikes in Dnipro and the Nikopol, Synelnykove, Kamianske and Dnipro districts damaged homes, energy and other infrastructure on 22 November, killing a woman in Dnipro and injuring nine others.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 10 hours ago: Russian attacks cause power outages in five Ukrainian oblasts.
As of the morning of 22 November, consumers in Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Rivne and Kharkiv oblasts remain without electricity after Russian strikes damaged energy facilities, forcing Odesa schools to switch to remote learning.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 17 hours ago: Schools in Odesa switch to remote learning due to power supply problems caused by Russian attacks.
Classes will be held remotely from 23 to 27 November as Russian strikes leave the city's electricity, heating and water supplies severely disrupted.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 12 hours ago: Russians strike gas service facility and two petrol stations, injuring people.
Naftogaz Group has reported an aerial bomb hit a gas service facility in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast – injuring one worker and causing two people to suffer from concussion – while two Ukrnafta petrol stations were attacked in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.
Southern Europe - bottom line: Congo warns that EU countries’ Rwanda deportation deal could fund armed militia.
- Politico Europe, just now: Congo warns that EU countries’ Rwanda deportation deal could fund armed militia.
EU countries are "making an informed choice to look the other way," Kinshasa's foreign affairs minister tells POLITICO.
- Politico Europe, 6 hours ago: Costa gives Macron early Christmas present on EU budget.
Governments have criticized European Council President António Costa's proposal on the bloc's 7-year budget for leaning toward France.
- Politico Europe, 10 hours ago: Global climate talks have collapsed. Here’s what just happened..
Two weeks of talks about protecting the planet from global warming ended without a deal.

AFRICA
Persian Gulf Region - bottom line: Ukraine strikes Russian vessels docked in Libya as another Russian ship burns in Finnish waters.
- Jerusalem Post, 10 hours ago: Ukraine strikes Russian vessels docked in Libya as another Russian ship burns in Finnish waters.
Ukraine has sent waves of military drones towards Russia's northwest coastal Leningrad region this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, one hour ago: Libya’s military says ‘fully prepared’ after Benghazi attacks.
Libyan military says Benghazi port is ‘under control’ and it is ‘fully prepared’ to respond to threats.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, 5 hours ago: Second ship targeted in series of naval drone attacks off Libyan coast.
A second attack has been reported on a commercial vessel flying a Maltese flag off Benghazi.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, 3 hours ago: WHO chief calls for peace amid heavy fighting in Ebola-hit DR Congo region.
Fighting near a DRC hospital disrupts Ebola efforts, putting patients and workers at 'grave risk', WHO warns.
Africa - bottom line: Ukraine: Up to seven feared trapped beneath rubble near Kyiv after Russian attack.
- Africanews, 17 hours ago: Ukraine: Up to seven feared trapped beneath rubble near Kyiv after Russian attack.
A Russian strike partially destroyed an apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, on Sunday. Nine people, including a child, were evacuated as rescuers searched the rubble for up to seven others feared trapped.
- Africanews, 11 hours ago: West Bank: Four Palestinian villages targeted in suspected settler attacks.
Burnt-out cars, damaged trucks and anti-Arab graffiti were discovered in four Palestinian villages in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday 22 November 2026, following overnight attacks blamed by local activists on Israeli settlers.

- South China Morning Post - China, The Moscow Times, 9 hours ago: Russian strikes kill at least 12 in Kyiv region, Ukraine says.
Rescuers in Ukraine raced on Monday to find residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats that partially collapsed in a Russian strike, after overnight attacks on the Kyiv region killed at least 12 people. Moscow has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter, as the full-scale invasion grinds through its fifth year. A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship Sunday at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. Small multirotor and first-person view drones are now widely used – and one of the most challenging new threats – on the modern battlefield. These drones are small, they fly at low altitudes usually off the traditional air defence radars, and combined with their manoeuvrability they are difficult to detect. When Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on November 19, the images were historic. The three leaders issued a four-point declaration towards peace, addressing UN reform, energy security, concerns over abuses of jurisdiction by the International Criminal Court, and nuclear risk reduction. India - bottom line: Trump threatens fresh strikes on Iran after New Year if talks fail.
- Times of India - Top Stories, Jerusalem Post, 7 hours ago: Trump threatens fresh strikes on Iran after New Year if talks fail.
US President Donald Trump has issued a warning to Iran regarding potential military strikes after New Year. He accused Tehran of stalling negotiations and escalating military aggression. Iranian officials were described as being more aggressive in their diplomatic efforts post-elections. The IRGC claimed responsibility for attacks on US military positions in Bahrain in recent conflicts. Additionally, anti-government protests reportedly re-emerged in Iran, with Trump encouraging demonstrators to continue their protests.

Authorities said one of the shooters, a 29-year-old man, was taken into custody, but he wasn't immediately charged. A second suspected shooter, a 19-year-old man, was one of the people killed, police said
